descriptionAdvanced.de: Moose Jaw liegt in der Provinz Saskatchewan am Zusammenfluss des Moose Jaw River und des Thunder Creek, etwa 77 Kilometer westlich der Hauptstadt Regina. Die Stadt wurde 1882 mit der Ankunft der Canadian Pacific Railway gegründet und entwickelte sich zu einem wichtigen Eisenbahnknotenpunkt in der Prärie. In den 1920er Jahren erlangte Moose Jaw als 'Little Chicago' Bekanntheit, da die unterirdischen Tunnel der Stadt angeblich von Schmugglern während der US-Prohibitionszeit genutzt wurden. Heute sind diese 'Tunnels of Moose Jaw' eine bedeutende Touristenattraktion und vermitteln einen Einblick in die bewegte Geschichte der Prohibition und der chinesischen Einwanderer. Moose Jaw beherbergt zudem die Basis der Royal Canadian Air Force, wo das berühmte Kunstflugteam 'Snowbirds' stationiert ist. Die Stadt ist auch für ihre natürlichen Thermalquellen bekannt, die das 'Temple Gardens Hotel' speisen und Moose Jaw zu einem Zentrum für Wellness in der Region machen. Ein markantes Wahrzeichen ist die Statue 'Mac the Moose', die mit fast 10 Metern Höhe als einer der größten Elche der Welt gilt.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Moose Jaw városa Saskatchewan tartomány déli részén fekszik, Regina tartományi fővárostól mintegy 77 kilométerre nyugatra, a Moose Jaw-folyó és a Thunder Creek találkozásánál. A települést 1882-ben alapították a Canadian Pacific Railway vasútvonal megépítésekor, és hamarosan a kanadai préri egyik meghatározó közlekedési csomópontjává vált. Az 1920-as években a város a 'Kis Chicago' nevet kapta, mivel a föld alatti alagútrendszert állítólag szeszcsempészek használták az amerikai alkoholtilalom idején. Napjainkban a 'Moose Jaw alagútjai' a város legnépszerűbb turisztikai látványossága, bemutatva a tiltott szerencsejátékok és a kínai bevándorlók küzdelmes történetét. A város ad otthont a Kanadai Királyi Légierő egyik fontos bázisának, ahol a híres 'Snowbirds' műrepülő csapat állomásozik. Moose Jaw természetes termálvizeiről is híres, amelyek a Temple Gardens gyógyfürdőt táplálják, így a régió fontos wellness-központja. A város jelképe a 'Mac, a jávorszarvas' szobor, amely közel 10 méteres magasságával a világ egyik legnagyobb jávorszarvas-ábrázolása.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Moose Jaw este situat în provincia Saskatchewan, la confluența râului Moose Jaw cu pârâul Thunder, la aproximativ 77 de kilometri vest de capitala Regina. Orașul a fost întemeiat în 1882 odată cu sosirea căii ferate Canadian Pacific Railway, devenind un nod feroviar esențial în zona prerierii. În anii 1920, Moose Jaw a devenit cunoscut sub numele de 'Micul Chicago' din cauza rețelei de tuneluri subterane despre care se spune că au fost folosite de contrabandistul Al Capone în timpul Prohibiției din SUA. Astăzi, aceste tuneluri sunt o atracție turistică majoră, oferind lecții de istorie despre epoca prohibiției și condițiile de viață ale imigranților chinezi. Orașul găzduiește baza aeriană a Royal Canadian Air Force, locul de antrenament al celebrei echipe de acrobație aeriană 'Snowbirds'. Moose Jaw este, de asemenea, apreciat pentru izvoarele sale termale naturale care alimentează complexul Temple Gardens, făcându-l o destinație populară pentru relaxare. Simbolul orașului este statuia 'Mac the Moose', care, cu o înălțime de aproape 10 metri, este considerată unul dintre cei mai mari elani din lume.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Moose Jaw is located in the province of Saskatchewan at the confluence of the Moose Jaw River and Thunder Creek, about 77 kilometers west of the capital city, Regina. The city was established in 1882 following the arrival of the Canadian Pacific Railway, quickly becoming a vital rail hub in the Canadian Prairies. During the 1920s, Moose Jaw earned the nickname 'Little Chicago' due to its underground tunnel network, which was allegedly used by bootleggers during the American Prohibition era. Today, the Tunnels of Moose Jaw are a premier tourist attraction, detailing the history of prohibition-era crime and the struggles of early Chinese immigrants. The city is home to the 15 Wing Moose Jaw airbase, where the Royal Canadian Air Force's world-famous 'Snowbirds' aerobatics team is stationed. Moose Jaw is also renowned for its geothermal mineral springs, which supply the Temple Gardens Mineral Spa, making it a key wellness destination in the region. A notable landmark is 'Mac the Moose', a statue standing nearly 10 meters tall, recognized as one of the largest moose statues in the world.
descriptionAdvanced.es: Moose Jaw se encuentra en el sur de Saskatchewan, a unos 75 kilómetros al oeste de Regina, a orillas del río Moose Jaw. Con unos 35.000 habitantes, es una de las ciudades más antiguas de la provincia y posee una rica historia ferroviaria y de contrabando. Moose Jaw se hizo famosa por los 'Tunnels of Moose Jaw', un sistema de túneles subterráneos que supuestamente se utilizaba como ruta de contrabando durante la Ley Seca y donde Al Capone habría hecho negocios. Hoy en día, la ciudad es un destino turístico popular con los baños de agua caliente Temple Gardens, el gigante Moose Mac y la patrulla acrobática Snowbirds de la Real Fuerza Aérea Canadiense.
descriptionAdvanced.pt: Moose Jaw está localizada no sul de Saskatchewan, a cerca de 75 quilómetros a oeste de Regina, nas margens do rio Moose Jaw. Com cerca de 35.000 habitantes, é uma das cidades mais antigas da província e possui uma rica história ferroviária e de contrabando. Moose Jaw tornou-se famosa pelos 'Tunnels of Moose Jaw', um sistema de túneis subterrâneos que terá sido utilizado como rota de contrabando durante a Lei Seca e onde se diz que Al Capone fez negócios. Hoje, a cidade é um destino turístico popular com os banhos de água quente Temple Gardens, o gigante Mac the Moose e a esquadrilha de acrobacia aérea Snowbirds da Força Aérea Real Canadense.
descriptionAdvanced.fr: Moose Jaw est située dans le sud de la Saskatchewan, à environ 75 kilomètres à l'ouest de Regina, sur les rives de la rivière Moose Jaw. Avec environ 35 000 habitants, elle est l'une des plus anciennes villes de la province et possède une riche histoire ferroviaire et de contrebande. Moose Jaw est devenue célèbre pour les « Tunnels of Moose Jaw », un système de tunnels souterrains qui aurait été utilisé comme route de contrebande pendant la prohibition et où Al Capone aurait fait des affaires. Aujourd'hui, la ville est une destination touristique prisée avec les bains d'eau chaude Temple Gardens, le géant Mac the Moose et la patrouille acrobatique Snowbirds de l'Aviation royale canadienne.

en: Moose Jaw was officially established as a settlement in 1882 near the railway line.
The underground tunnels were originally built to maintain the steam heating systems of downtown buildings.
The RCAF's 'Snowbirds' aerobatic team has been based in Moose Jaw since its formation in 1971.
The 'Mac the Moose' statue weighs approximately 10 tons and was completed in 1984.
Moose Jaw is currently the fourth-largest city in the province of Saskatchewan.
The geothermal mineral springs in Moose Jaw were accidentally discovered in 1910 during a gas drilling project.
